injuries.detail: Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Reaves (heel) to return for Monday's matchup with Utah or Friday's game in San Antonio, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.c
Achiuwa (lower leg) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Lakers.
Hunter (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
